name: c-combobox-1
title: A basic combobox with a list of options
label: Basic
description: A basic combobox with a list of options

guidance.bestFor: The minimal single pick wiring: a string array filtered by typing, with a no results message

whenNotToUse.when: Options sorted under headings such as world regions

name: c-combobox-2
title: A disabled combobox
label: Disabled
description: A disabled combobox

guidance.bestFor: A locked single field whose input and chevron are both disabled, so neither typing nor clicking opens it

name: c-combobox-3
title: A combobox in an invalid state
label: Invalid
description: A combobox in an invalid state

guidance.bestFor: A labelled field marked invalid through aria-invalid, with a required message printed under it
agentNotes: `data-invalid` and `aria-invalid` are always on and `FieldError` prints a fixed message; drive all three from your validation

name: c-combobox-4
title: A combobox with a clear button
label: Clear Button
description: A combobox with a clear button

guidance.bestFor: A field preset to Next.js whose X empties it, with the X standing in for the chevron while a value is set

whenNotToUse.when: Free typed text with an X, where any typed value is kept as is

name: c-combobox-5
title: A combobox with auto-highlight enabled
label: Auto-Highlight
description: A combobox with auto-highlight enabled

guidance.bestFor: The first match highlighted as the user types, so Enter picks it without an arrow key press

name: c-combobox-6
title: A combobox with grouped options
label: Grouped Options
description: A combobox with grouped options

guidance.bestFor: Timezones listed under Americas, Europe and Asia Pacific headings, with the typed search narrowing every region
agentNotes: Grouped data follows the `timezones` shape of `value` plus `items`; the root detects it and filters inside each `ComboboxGroup`

whenNotToUse.when: Region groups that need a divider line between them

name: c-combobox-7
title: A combobox with grouped options and separators
label: Group Separators
description: A combobox with grouped options and separators

guidance.bestFor: The regional timezone list with a thin rule placed inside each group, under that group's last row
agentNotes: The group-last class on `ComboboxSeparator` never matches, as no `ComboboxGroup` declares that group name, so a rule still shows under the last group

name: c-combobox-8
title: A combobox with a large list of options
label: Large List
description: A combobox with a large list of options

guidance.bestFor: A long generated list of 100 entries that scrolls inside the popup and narrows as the user types
agentNotes: `largeListItems` mounts all 100 rows in the popup at once with nothing virtualized, so thousands of options need a windowed list

name: c-combobox-9
title: A combobox with an icon addon
label: Icon Addon
description: A combobox with an icon addon

guidance.bestFor: A leading globe glyph inside the field, passed to the input as an InputGroupAddon child
agentNotes: Children of `ComboboxInput` render inside its `InputGroup`, so the `InputGroupAddon` lands at the start through its default align

name: c-combobox-10
title: A combobox rendered inside a popup
label: Country Picker
description: A combobox rendered inside a popup

guidance.bestFor: A country picker whose outline button shows the chosen flag and name, with the search box moved inside the popup
agentNotes: Flags load from `flagcdn.com` by each country `code`; self host them or swap the source before shipping

name: c-combobox-11
title: A combobox used within a form
label: In Form
description: A combobox used within a form

guidance.bestFor: A labelled required field inside a form element, read back through FormData when Submit is pressed
agentNotes: `handleSubmit` reads `framework` from `FormData` and only shows a `toast`, which needs a mounted Sonner toaster; send it to your API there

name: c-combobox-12
title: A multi-select combobox
label: Multi-Select
description: A multi-select combobox

guidance.bestFor: Chips for each chosen framework with an X on each, typed into from an input that sits after the last chip
agentNotes: The `useComboboxAnchor` ref goes on `ComboboxChips` and on `anchor` of `ComboboxContent`, so the popup lines up with the whole chip box

whenNotToUse.when: Chosen people shown as round chips with their avatar

name: c-combobox-13
title: A disabled multi-select combobox
label: Disabled Multi-Select
description: A disabled multi-select combobox

guidance.bestFor: A locked multi value field holding 2 preset chips, disabled at the root rather than on the input
agentNotes: `disabled` on the `Combobox` root also disables each chip's remove button, so no pick can be dropped

whenNotToUse.when: Chips the user can still add to and take away

name: c-combobox-14
title: A multi-select combobox in an invalid state
label: Invalid Multi-Select
description: A multi-select combobox in an invalid state

guidance.bestFor: The multi value chip field in its error state, with aria-invalid on the chip input and a message below
agentNotes: `data-invalid`, `aria-invalid` on `ComboboxChipsInput` and the `FieldError` message are all hardcoded; set the three from your validation result

name: c-combobox-15
title: A multi-select with chips that cannot be removed
label: Non-Removable Chips
description: A multi-select with chips that cannot be removed

guidance.bestFor: Preset chips drawn without an X button, for picks the chip itself should not offer to dismiss
agentNotes: `showRemove` set to false only hides the X; Backspace in an empty `ComboboxChipsInput` still removes the last chip

name: c-combobox-16
title: A combobox with custom item rendering
label: Custom Items
description: A combobox with custom item rendering

guidance.bestFor: A member picker whose button shows the chosen avatar, with rows listing each person's photo, name and job title
agentNotes: `members` has no label field and `itemToStringValue` does not feed search, so typing matches emails and photo URLs too; pass itemToStringLabel returning `name`

name: c-combobox-17
title: A combobox used within a dialog
label: In Dialog
description: A combobox used within a dialog

guidance.bestFor: A framework pick placed in a modal with a hidden label and Cancel and Confirm buttons in its footer
agentNotes: Confirm only calls `toast` and closes; the uncontrolled `Combobox` keeps its pick inside, so lift `value` into state to read it
The radix twin sets `modal` to false on `Dialog` while the base twin stays modal; keep that difference when porting

name: c-combobox-18
title: A combobox with a custom trigger icon
label: Custom Trigger Icon
description: A combobox with a custom trigger icon

guidance.bestFor: A chevrons up and down glyph shown only while the field is empty, giving way to the X once a value is picked
agentNotes: Imports `ComboboxPrimitive` from `@base-ui/react` directly, because the wrapped `ComboboxTrigger` always draws its own chevron

whenNotToUse.when: The stock chevron and a preselected value with no custom trigger

name: c-combobox-19
title: A multi-select combobox with user tags
label: User Tags
description: A multi-select combobox with user tags

guidance.bestFor: Team members as rounded pill chips with a small avatar, picked from rows that show each person's position
agentNotes: Search matches each whole `members` entry as JSON, since it has no label field; return `name` from itemToStringLabel to match names only

whenNotToUse.when: Chips that blend into the page with the field box stripped away

name: c-combobox-20
title: Invisible combobox with member tags
label: Invisible Tags
description: Invisible combobox with member tags

guidance.bestFor: Member pills sitting loose on the page with no field border, ring or background around them
agentNotes: The `ComboboxChips` class turns off the border, background, padding and focus ring that the field normally draws

whenNotToUse.when: Avatar chips held inside a bordered field box

name: c-combobox-21
title: A status change combobox
label: Status Change
description: A status change combobox

guidance.bestFor: Workflow states from Backlog to Cancelled, each with its own tinted circle glyph on the button and in the list
agentNotes: `StatusGlyph` switches on each `tone` in `statusOptions`; a new status needs its own case there or it renders no glyph

name: c-combobox-22
title: A priority change combobox
label: Priority Change
description: A priority change combobox

guidance.bestFor: Priority levels drawn as 3 step signal bars, with Urgent shown as a yellow warning sign
agentNotes: `LowPriorityIcon`, `MediumPriorityIcon` and `HighPriorityIcon` are inline SVG, not `IconPlaceholder`, so an icon library swap leaves them as drawn

name: c-combobox-23
title: A lead selection combobox
label: Lead Selection
description: A lead selection combobox

guidance.bestFor: A single lead picked from a Team members group of avatar rows, marked You for the signed in user, or No lead
agentNotes: `ComboboxGroup` gets the full `teamMembers` array, so typing in `ComboboxInput` never hides a member row
`isCurrentUser` adds the You suffix to one row of `teamMembers`; set it from your signed in user

whenNotToUse.when: Assigning work to 1 person, with an invite row for new users

name: c-combobox-24
title: A multi-member selection combobox
label: Member Selection
description: A multi-member selection combobox

guidance.bestFor: Several people summarised on the button as up to 4 stacked avatars and a member count
agentNotes: Rows come from a static `teamMembers` map, so the search box never hides one; render them from a function child of `ComboboxList` to filter
Picking `noMembersOption` empties the selection in `handleMembersChange`, and `isMemberSelectionItemEqual` matches rows by `id`

whenNotToUse.when: Exactly 1 person per task shown with a single avatar

name: c-combobox-25
title: A date selection combobox with an optional custom picker dialog
label: Date Selection
description: A date selection combobox with an optional custom picker dialog

guidance.bestFor: Date presets such as Tomorrow and End of month beside their dates, plus a Custom row opening a 2 month calendar dialog
agentNotes: Picking `customDateOption` opens the `Dialog` rather than selecting, and only Confirm in `handleConfirmCustomDate` commits `draftDate`
Each `searchText` reaches only `itemToStringValue`, which sets the submitted value, so its keywords are never matched by any search

whenNotToUse.when: A period typed as text, or chosen as a range, quarter, half year or year

name: c-combobox-26
title: A multi-label selection combobox with a no-label mode
label: Label Selection
description: A multi-label selection combobox with a no-label mode

guidance.bestFor: Issue labels marked by colored dots, the button showing one label's name or up to 3 dots plus a count of the rest
agentNotes: `labelOptions` render as static rows, so typing in `ComboboxInput` filters nothing; move them into the function child of `ComboboxList`
`handleLabelsChange` empties the selection whenever `noLabelOption` is picked, so the No label row acts as a clear action

name: c-combobox-27
title: A team selection combobox
label: Team Selection
description: A team selection combobox

guidance.bestFor: One owning team per record, each marked by its own tinted glyph, with a No team row to unset it
agentNotes: The `teamOptions` rows are mapped by hand outside the list's render function, so a typed query leaves every team in view
`TeamMark` falls back to the sparkles glyph for an unknown `tone`, and `teamToneClassName` needs an entry for each tone to color it

whenNotToUse.when: A person rather than a team, shown with an avatar

name: c-combobox-28
title: An assignee selection combobox
label: Assignee Selection
description: An assignee selection combobox

guidance.bestFor: A single assignee chosen from avatar rows, with No assignee on top and an Invite row in its own New user group
agentNotes: `handleAssigneeChange` returns early on the `inviteOption` row, so wire your invite flow there
Both `ComboboxGroup` parts get fixed arrays, `teamMembers` and the invite row, so the search box narrows neither group

whenNotToUse.when: Several assignees at once summed up as stacked avatars
